parameters.query:
INSERT INTO akne_decision_threads (decision_id, file_path, slack_thread_ts, slack_channel, github_repo, decision_context)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Parse Decision Detail').first().json.decision_id }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Decision Detail').first().json.decision_path }}',
  '{{ $('Post Detail to Slack').first().json.ts }}',
  '{{ $('Post Detail to Slack').first().json.channel }}',
  'elevenyellow/akne',
  '{{ $('Parse Decision Detail').first().json.full_content.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (decision_id) DO UPDATE SET
  slack_thread_ts = EXCLUDED.slack_thread_ts,
  slack_channel = EXCLUDED.slack_channel,
  updated_at = NOW()
